metadata.description: Small Claude Code mods that make long sessions easier

plugins.name: next-prompts
plugins.description: Clickable follow-up prompts above the input: click one to put it in the prompt box, unsent

plugins.name: trash-guard
plugins.description: Claude never deletes for good: rm, git clean and find -delete are refused outside temp folders, and Claude uses the Trash instead

plugins.name: turn-progress
plugins.description: While Claude works: elapsed time, actions, the current step, todo progress and running subagents above the prompt

plugins.name: session-links
plugins.description: Local dev servers and deploy URLs from the session, one click away above the prompt, dimmed when the server is down

plugins.name: paid-api-meter
plugins.description: Counts the session's calls to paid generation APIs (image, video, voice, LLM) and adds up reported costs

plugins.name: done-notify
plugins.description: A desktop notification when a long turn ends, telling you whether Claude is done or waiting for you

plugins.name: inline-images
plugins.description: Shows images inline in the terminal: a show_image tool for Claude, plus pasted images and images Claude reads, Orca included

plugins.name: paste-peek
plugins.description: Read and fix a long paste before you send it: Edit unfolds a [Pasted text #n] placeholder back into the prompt, View opens it in a pane

plugins.name: bang-commands
plugins.description: When Claude asks you to run `! command` yourself, click the command: it lands in the prompt in real bash mode, press Enter

plugins.name: prompt-select
plugins.description: Experimental, macOS + Hammerspoon: Cmd+A selects your prompt, then Delete clears it, Cmd+C copies it, typing replaces it
